en: The head of the entire Kanto region...

"Humbled himself to ask this of some
tiny outfit like the Yamagasa Family."

"Not exactly a common occurrence,
as I'm sure you're well aware."

"Ever since, I've been sharing the information
relayed to me by Mayumi with Chairman Dojima."
And your connection to Mayumi?
We're family.
Mayumi is my daughter.
You'd send your daughter? Really?

"The fact that you were in Fukuoka
had to be kept secret at all costs."

"I could only entrust the task
to someone I trusted unconditionally."

"Only natural then for me to give the
responsibility to Mayumi, my own flesh and blood."

"Though, had I known what kind of man
Kazuma Kiryu was from the get-go..."

"I might have thought twice about
letting her anywhere near you."
Why's that?
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1315 + subtítulo de escena B2170 …

en: She's clearly fallen for you.
I'm her father.

"I can't bear to see her struggle with
feelings that'll never be reciprocated."
Kiryu-san. Here.

"A declaration dissolving
the Yamagasa Family."

"Can I entrust this to you,
to take to the police?"
Why?
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1315 + subtítulo de escena E5210 …

en: Why dissolve the family?

"My men have grown too big
to live in my little castle anymore."
The Yamagasa Family's always been small.
But it seems I took in too many children.

"And now it's even put a strain on our
relationship with the Tojo Clan."

"The best I can do for my boys is to
make sure they get a chance at life."
Madarame-san.
We'd cease to be yakuza anymore.

"And by ceding our turf, the Tojo Clan and the
Omi Alliance would no longer be gunning for us."
That's simply the safest option now.
If you're really going through with this...

"It would only be fair if your men heard
it directly from you. Right?"

"Better to let the long arm
of the law do what it does."

"Breaking up the family puts us
at the mercy of law enforcement."

"Not even the Tojo Clan or the Omi
Alliance would want to bother with that."
Still. Why me?
Just look at me.

"On top of that, I think if you
were the one handing in the declaration..."
Yahata may actually accept it.
Your captain?
You and he came to blows last night.
You know, he's not the brightest bulb.

"Fighting is how he comes
to understand a man."

"I guess you could call that
his silver lining."

"I'm actually glad you got into a
scrap with Yahata before this."

"I know that I'm asking you
to bear quite a burden."
But please. Grant an old fool his wish.

"You're the only one I can
trust to do it right."
So please...
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1320 + subtítulo de escena C3256

en:
"Will you please do this
favor for my father?"
I'm not the man you think I am.
Me, your father, and that Aoyama guy...
We're all yakuza.

"But being yakuza doesn't
make us all the same."

"I'm far from ideal, but I'd never
turn down a good man's request."
I'll pass this on.
What? But...

"Call it a soft spot for brats who
grew up in the margins."

"If this is what you want,
I'll make your wishes known."
I guess I wasn't alone here.
How could I have been?

"Regardless of why, I'm glad you put a good
woman at my side when I was at my lowest."
Thank you for that.

"So I won't let Aoyama get away with this.
That much I can promise you."
I'm so sorry, Mayumi.

"If you want to go after him,
you better get moving!"

"If that's what you want,
I won't stand in your way."
Mayumi...
Not another word, please.
This is hard enough as it is.
Please...
Dad!
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1320 + diálogo uid010c0c62

en: Hey, it's that asshole!
Easy, boys.
But cap, he's...!
I said stand down, y'buncha morons!
Y'got business here?
What's that?
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1335 + subtítulo de escena B2310 …

en: Word from Madarame.

"It's a declaration dissolving
the Yamagasa Family."

"Figures. It's just like
the old man to pull this."

"He wrote this to protect you.
And entrusted it to me."
What, not gonna tear it up?

"We're only livin' on this green earth to
serve Patriarch Madarame."

"It don't even matter what
happens to the Yamagasa Family."
We'd avenge the boss either way.
He's all we got.
I ain't that dense.

"It was that Aoyama fucker from the
Tojo Clan who knifed the patriarch."
Figured it out when HQ got blown to shit.
You ain't the type to stoop that low.

"So let me get this straight.
Even if the Yamagasa crumbles..."
You still want revenge on Aoyama?

"Damn straight. This ain't about turf
or protocols or relations anymore."
It's one-hundred percent pure yakuza justice.
All right, then.
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1335 + diálogo uid01340012

en: The shit? What'd ya do that for!?
The Yamagasa Family isn't disbanding.
There's something I need you to do.
Y'givin' us orders?

"For better or worse, the Yamagasa
Family keeps this town in balance."

"If the Yamagasa is out of the picture,
other groups are just going to muscle in."
Wouldn't be great for business.
What business?

"I don't really look the part,
but I drive a taxi in town."
So I can't let the Yamagasa just fade away.

"You still have a job to do here.
Get this city back on its feet."
Huh!? Y'ain't makin' a lick o' sense!

"Keep stickin' yer nose where it
don't belong, and I'll chop it off!"

"That's the right attitude.
But you'll need more than that."

"If you make a run at the Tojo Clan now,
you'd all end up leaving in body bags."
What'd you say!?

"If you still want to go after Aoyama,
I won't stand in your way."
But first...
Huh!? What're ya smokin'!?
First round was just a warm-up.

"This time I'm puttin' ya
in the ground fer sure."
Then shut up and show me.
I'm ready when you are.
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1335 + subtítulo de escena E5180

en: Acting Chairman.
It's from the Yamagasa captain, Yahata.
Yahata?
So he survived.
Do you want me to hang up?
He's after a deal.
Give it.
This is Aoyama.

"The Tojo Clan has no intention
of cutting a deal with you."
Our houses are in open war.
Are you sure that's wise?
I'm not sure I understand.
Might as well make a spectacle outta it.

"Tomorrow night. Hakata pier,
Warehouse 27."
Ya got that?
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1350 + subtítulo de escena B2350

en:
"I'm lookin' forward to
cavin' yer damn face in."
That good enough, Kiryu-san?
What did they say, Acting Chairman?

"They want an old-fashioned battle.
Even gave us a time and place."

"A full-on brawl at the
pier tomorrow night."
What, like some afterschool fist fight?
It may even be a trap.
Apologies, sir.

"Put the word out to everyone
still down in Fukuoka."

"That sworn brother of mine may
finally have a use, too."
Yo! Where's that bitch-ass Aoyama at?
Don't tell me he chickened out!

"You worthless rednecks aren't
worth the acting chairman's time!"

"Of course not. The general doesn't
dirty his hands doing a soldier's job."

"You're missin' out. Nothin' gets the
adrenaline pumpin' like punchin' guys."
Brutality gives me no pleasure.
Then why'd ya drag me all the way out here?
I thought ya needed backup.

"Call it an insurance policy.
In case a certain someone shows up."
Who're ya talkin'?

"Well, looks like they're ready.
Sit back and enjoy the fireworks."
Time's up. Let's start this thing!
Aren't you...
But this fight's mine.
Fourth Chairman!?
Not anymore I'm not.
It's truly an honor!
I'm here to help, all right.
But not you.
So I'm gonna put you on the right path.
I figured you'd show up eventually.
Kiryu-san. The times have changed!

"A war isn't about who locks
fists with whom anymore."
You old timers never change.
Watch your fuckin' mouth.
Watase!?
I accept your conditions!

"If Kiryu-han takes out every one of these Tojo chumps,
then there's no war with the Yamagasa."
You can't do that, Watase!

"I'm the captain of the Omi Alliance, and
patriarch of the Watase Family."
Ya really wanna challenge me, brother?
All right, let's get this shit started!
I'll be bearin' witness to this brawl!
What are you waiting for!?

"Don't be scared because he's
the fourth chairman! Get him!"
He's right. No need to hold back.
Now if you want to die... bring it!
What the shit...
How!?
I'm done playing with you.
Brother! What do you think you're doing!?

"Can't have ya firin' that thing and
shamin' my rep as a witness."
Ya don't wanna tarnish my name, do ya?
Come on! This wasn't the deal!
I ain't your soldier.

"When I fight him, it'll be
on my terms, ya fuckwit!"
Damn you!
This isn't what I heard!
They said you never kill.
That you're merciful.
Who told you that?
Well...
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1380 + subtítulo de escena B2330 …

en: I said, who told you that?
Some other Tojo men.
Whatever you heard...
I've never been a saint!
I can hide from my past all I want.
But no matter how much I hate it...
I'll always be yakuza.
Being clever only gets you so far in this business.

"Just remember.
This is your last warning."
Why me of all people?

"Had I known this would happen,
I never would have agreed."
Quit your whimperin'!

"You wanna helm the Tojo Clan!?
Then you're gonna have to grow a pair!"
Or are ya determined to disappoint me!?
What do ya got to say, brother!?
I did as I was told.
It was... your...
Brother...
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1380 + diálogo uid01020b6c

en: Hey, bro!
You talk too much, Acting Chairman.

"I hadn't planned on seeing
you again like this, Fourth Chairman."

"Not another step!
Next one's through your brain."
What's your game here?
How long have you been betraying Daigo?
Betrayal, you say?
If you ask me, that's the real betrayal.
And Aoyama shooting you.
Was that all part of the act!?

"My job in this was to get
you where you needed to be."

"Just like Chairman Madarame,
I was prepared for every scenario."
Then you and Aoyama were in league.
Why take him out?
No one likes a yakuza with loose lips.
What secrets?
Stop, Morinaga!

"What is it? I'm not going to tell you
what I'm doing, if that's what you want."
I don't care what you're doing!
I only need to know one thing!
Where's Aizawa?
If he'd known you'd turned on Daigo...

"He would have told me,
no matter the circumstances."
So answer me, Morinaga.
I want the truth. Where is Aizawa?
He truly was one of the good guys.

"But he knew too much.
Too much to turn the other way."
No... You didn't!

"He's up on Mount Inuboe.
Six feet under."
Morinaga...
You piece of...!
I said, don't move!
Stop! Stop, damn you!
Leave him! Now ain't the time!
There's a lot more I have to do before I die.
You'll find your answers up in Tokyo.
I'll be waiting, Kiryu-san.
Two days since the big scrap...

"And you're back on the clock.
Helluva work ethic."
You again?
Heard you put on quite a show.
Don't know what you're talking about.
It's no use hidin' things from me.
So, how's the leg?
I got ya.

"So you know, Watase headed
back to Kansai this morning."

"Heard he stopped by the
police morgue on his way."

"Wanted to light some incense
for Aoyama, apparently."

"Crazy. He didn't even realize
Aoyama was tryin' to use him."
Bit of a moron, huh?

"Kinda surprisin' that the Omi keeps
old-school guys like him around."
Almost makes me proud of 'em.
Forget it.
ctx: subtítulo de escena A1390 + diálogo uid00091cc7 …

en: I know that's strange comin' from me.
He should be the sharpest thorn in my side...
Man, guess I'm goin' soft.
Would you say you two are close?
Hell nah.
But when ya been on the force long as I have...
Even your enemy starts makin' ya sentimental.
That's kinda how me n' Watase are.
Oh, by the way...

"Watase told the local detectives
to give you his regards."
To me?
Yeah, said he'd settle the Omi side.
Then settle the score in Tokyo.
You're goin' too, right?

"Before you go. They found a body on
Mount Inuboe this morning."

"The face was pretty jacked up,
so they haven't confirmed an ID yet."
But there was a Tojo pin on the lapel.
Ya sure you can stay outta this?

"You may be the only one who
can sail the Tojo through this storm."

"But those are the only directions
I'll be taking from you."
The path I walk... is mine to decide.
I get ya. Have it your way.

"But you may wanna flip to
the news before ya decide."

"I think you and I are gonna be
gettin' to know each other real good soon."

"Again, our top story today is the Sapporo
shooting incident early yesterday morning."
Hokkaido Police have determined...

"The victim was a senior member of Kanto's
organized crime syndicate, the Tojo Clan."
He's been identified as Goro Majima.

"Details were released at
an impromptu press conference."

"Given the victim's status as a member
of the largest crime syndicate in Kanto..."

"Hokkaido Police are taking extra precautions to
determine the circumstances of Goro Majima's death."

"They also plan to work alongside the Tokyo
Metropolitan police in the investigation."
We go now to the weather.

"Here's our meteorologist, Hayashida-san.
Hayashida-san?"
Sorry, Haruka.
Why're we in this dump?

"There's gotta be a million
better BBQ joints than this!"
Less whinin', more eatin'.

"Your last meal on the outside
and it's in freakin' Kamurocho."
Our usual spot at that.
Ain't a more pathetic sight.
What's so wrong with it?
Now c'mon, eat up before it burns.
Hey, lady! 'Nother plate o' tripe!
Coming up!
Don't got the stomach I used to.
Fatty meat just tastes like shit now.
